deployment.commit_message:
GAP-FILL: fix fail-open regression in site-builder-customization-ui-routes.js founder gate

A parallel commit (154d03e18) fixed the missing-service-imports crash in this
file (inlined in-memory stubs) but in the same edit rewrote all 5 isFounder
checks from `!deps.isFounder` (fail-closed) to `deps.isFounder === false`
(fail-open on undefined).

deps.isFounder is never set anywhere else in the codebase (confirmed via
full-repo grep) — no auth middleware or deps-construction code populates it.
In the real request path it is always undefined, and `undefined === false`
is false, so the 403 branch never executes. The gate looks present in the
code but is silently always-bypassed — worse than the original bug (missing
check entirely) because it no longer looks broken on inspection.

Fix: rewrote the condition to `!(deps && deps.isFounder === true)` across all
5 routes — fail-closed by default, only opens when a caller explicitly sets
isFounder: true. Verified live: undefined isFounder -> 403 on all 5 routes;
isFounder: true -> 200 on all 5.

Not a live risk today (file still unregistered in
config/auto-registered-product-modules.json), but must not ship live in the
fail-open state.

HAND-AUTHORED-JUSTIFICATION: narrow security correctness fix restoring the
fail-closed default that was already correct in my own prior commit
(0aa0ccaeb) before an unrelated parallel edit weakened it — not new logic.
